topHook: America lost money on every penny it made

scenes.vo: [calm, curious] Every penny America made cost almost four cents.
scenes.label: to make one penny (US Mint, 2024)

scenes.vo: Zinc inside. A thin skin of copper. Pressed, packed and shipped.
And the Mint made more than three billion of them in a year.
scenes.label: pennies shipped in one year

scenes.vo: [lowered] So the government did something it hadn't done in two hundred thirty-two years.
scenes.label: years of pennies (1793–2025)

scenes.vo: Last November, in Philadelphia, it pressed the final penny.
It says that saves fifty-six million dollars.
scenes.label: saved, says the US Treasury

scenes.vo: [quiet, knowing] Your old pennies still work. There just won't be any new ones.
